justification: Couple of things to handle this week, plain and simple. Omarion's on his bye, so Dowdle steps into that RB spot — he said he's good to go and he's shown up to work all week, that Questionable tag doesn't scare me. Terry's Out, so Amon-Ra comes off the bench into that flex spot, no drama there, just the next man up who's earned the look. Chargers are on their bye too, and that's exactly why we went and got Houston a couple weeks back instead of leaving a hole — they've done their job all year against a beat-up Giants team, so they're in. Daniel Jones put together a real outing last week, twenty-two completions and a score, and a pro like that doesn't lose his job over one rough interception stretch — he's starting. And Mark Andrews only got a half a point last week, but I watched the tape, the man competed, snaps were there, targets were there, it just didn't bounce his way — that's a guy who gets one more week to respond, not a guy you bury. Clear eyes, full hearts, we keep building it the right way.
